meta.title: SLATE research: a luggage catalog and airline bag limits (US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Mexico)
meta.readFor: src/engine/systems/luggage.ts, which on 2026-10-02 kept one starter 'Carry-On Suitcase' holding 45 L (CARRY_ON.holdsL) and nothing else to buy.
meta.method: Prices and specifications were read on 2026-10-02 from the maker's or retailer's own page: Shopify product JSON (travelpro.com, travelpro.ca, monos.com, briggs-riley.com, itluggage.com, antler.co.uk, herschel.ca), page structured data (awaytravel.com, americantourister.com.mx), Amazon product pages read directly (amazon.com, .ca, .co.uk, .ie, .com.mx), and product pages on johnlewis.com, samsonite.co.uk, samsonite.ie, samsonite.com.mx, americantourister.ie and brownthomas.com. Those rows have confirmed:true. A row from a search-engine summary of a page that blocked automated reads has confirmed:false.

fields.type: carry-on | medium | large | backpack | duffel. 'medium' and 'large' are checked sizes.
fields.capacityL: Liters as the maker or retailer publishes them, unexpanded. capacityExpandedL only where a figure is published; a page that gives only an expansion depth (e.g. '+5 cm') has capacityExpandedL null and the depth in expansion.
fields.dimensionsCm: Height x width x depth as published, including wheels and handles unless the note says otherwise. Where a page publishes inches only, the inches are in dimensionsIn and dimensionsCm is converted at 2.54 cm/in (noted).
fields.weightKg: As published; pounds converted at 0.4536 kg/lb where only pounds were published (noted).
fields.price: The regular price. salePrice is a promotional price shown at the same time, else null. On Amazon, price is the struck 'Typical price', 'List Price', 'RRP', 'Was' or 'Precio anterior' when the page showed one, and salePrice is the price the page charged; Amazon prices move daily and depend on the colour the page loaded.
fields.taxIncluded: false for US and Canada (sales tax/GST/HST added at checkout); true for UK and Ireland (VAT included) and Mexico (IVA included in shelf prices).
fields.wheels: Number of wheels where stated. Several makers fit 8 wheels as four double spinners; that is recorded as 8. null where the page says 'spinner' without a count.
fields.warrantyYears: Years as stated. 'lifetime' where the maker says lifetime; null where none is stated.

worthChecking: For SLATE's CARRY_ON.holdsL = 45: published carry-on volumes on these pages ran from 29 L (John Lewis Lisbon, 55 x 37 x 20 cm) to 46 L (Travelpro Maxlite 5, soft-sided, before expansion). Hardside carry-ons sized to 22 x 14 x 9 in / 55 x 40 x 20 cm were mostly 33.5-41 L; 45 L is at the top of the range and is reached mainly by soft cases or by expanding. Checked mediums ran 55-91 L and larges 87-142 L.

Amazon listings carry contradictory volume fields: the Amazon Basics LN20164 series shows 'Capacity 39 liters' for both the 26- and 30-inch sizes beside a different 'Storage Volume', and some Amazon.ca and Amazon.co.uk listings give inches labelled as centimetres. Those values were set to null rather than guessed.
Amazon prices on .ie and .com.mx showed several prices for one product; where the buy-box price was not isolated the row's price is null.
Away's Canadian and UK prices were read from those storefronts' structured data; the specifications were read on the US page and assumed identical for the same SKU (jet-black).

Samsonite C-Lite cabin is published differently in Mexico (40 L, 55 x 38 x 25 cm, 8 wheels) and in the UK/Ireland (36/42 L, 55 x 40 x 20/23 cm, 4 wheels); probably different variants (non-expandable 55/20 vs expandable). Both recorded as published.
Travelpro Maxlite 5 Large at 142 L is high for its stated 73.7 x 52.1 x 31.8 cm case; it is Travelpro's own figure.

Airline pages for American, United, British Airways, Ryanair, Aer Lingus and Aeroméxico blocked automated reads; their rows are confirmed:false and should be re-read in a browser before SLATE relies on them. A 22 x 14 x 9 in (56 x 36 x 23 cm) bag fits every North American limit read here except Air Canada's 55 x 40 x 23 cm on length (56 vs 55 cm); a 55 x 40 x 20 cm bag fits all of them except WestJet's 36 cm width.

Ryanair's free allowance is only the 40 x 30 x 20 cm under-seat bag; a wheeled carry-on needs Priority. Aer Lingus and Volaris weigh cabin bags (10 kg); the North American majors publish no carry-on weight limit.
Sale prices were widespread on the read date (Monos 15% off, Samsonite Mexico about 40% off, American Tourister Mexico about 40-50% off). The regular price is the one recorded as price.
